Adjacent paragraphs in a layout-table cell are separated rather than concatenated into one run of text

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { ConversionOptions, convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown";
function main() {
  const options: ConversionOptions = { compactTables: true };
  const result = convert("<table><tr><td><p><b>Alice Example</b></p><p><i>Customer Service</i></p></td><td>Logo</td></tr><tr><td>A</td><td>B</td><td>C</td></tr></table>", options);
  console.log(result.content);
}

void main();
```
